about_the_game:
Welcome to The Door, a narrative and psychological game where every choice confronts you with your own thoughts.

"What if every door you opened was a window into your own mind?"

In The Door, you will have to go through a series of trials where each door represents an inner reflection. Between light and darkness, hope and doubt, you will have to solve puzzles and make decisions to move forward. But will you be ready to face what your mind has in store for you?

Gameplay and main mechanics

  • A narrative game based on choices: each door plunges you into a dilemma to solve.

  • Symbolic puzzles: play with lighting and interactions to progress.

  • An immersive atmosphere: an intriguing narration accompanied by a striking sound atmosphere.

  • An introspective journey: explore themes such as solitude, failure and resilience.

  • A short but intense experience: designed to leave a lasting mark.
